memoryBuilder.verseText: God said: 'I will bring you out. I will buy you back.'

sequence.prompt: What happened when Moses went to Pharaoh? Put it in order.

items.label: Pharaoh said no and made it harder

matches.prompt: Match each one to what they did.

pairs.right: Said 'Let My people go!' again and again
Made his heart harder every time
Showed He is King over every king

application.question: Pharaoh made his heart hard every time. When is it hardest for you to say yes?

options.label: When I have to stop playing
When I have to say sorry

application.followUp: Pharaoh got a real chance every single time, and every time he said no. A soft heart says yes quickly — and God is stronger than anything holding you.
